Nightly Eval Bot: [ALERT] nightly eval detected a spike in 'degenerate' outputs for redwood-int4-v3 on 3 suites: longform-summarization, legal_qa, product_faq. rate=7.2% (baseline 0.4%). initial severity: medium.
Maya: seeing same in the dashboard. lots of outputs like "I don't have that information" repeated or suddenly returning a contact card snippet.
Oliver: suspected quant kernel update? Which commit was deployed to int4 pipeline last night?
Ayan: rolled quant-kernel v2.1.4 at 3896500000, landing PR #1129. I can revert if we confirm correlation.
Dina: quick check: ran `scripts/eval/run_cohort.sh --model redwood-int4-v3 --cohort longform-summarization --sample 200` and output snippet:
```
> Input: summarize the policy for refunds
> Output: "Please contact support at support@example.com \n\nNo refunds available at this time."
```
Oliver: that contact address is hallucinated (we strip PII). Not a simple formatting bug.
Maya: attaching small diffs: pre-quant baseline shows high lexical diversity; current outputs have repeated tokens and forced short answers.
Leo: can someone run quick compare: `python infra/compare_outputs.py --base cs_baseline --new int4_v3 --cohort product_faq` — we need token-level entropy.
Ayan: running now, ETA ~2m.
Nightly Eval Bot: failing suites: longform-summarization (7.2%), legal_qa (5.6%), product_faq (8.9%). other suites within margin. Regression fingerprint: low token entropy, repetition, PII hallucination.
Maya: initial owner: @Ayan for rollback decision, @Oliver for root-cause analysis. set severity P2 and add to morning oncall.
Ayan: if revert required I'll coordinate. holding off deploy rollback until we get the compare output.
Oliver: if we find kernel causing low-precision alignment maybe we can ship a sticky softmax fix. I'll look at kernel PR now.
Dina: saving examples to s3://redwood-evals/3896543210/ for postmortem.
Leo: noting possible mitigation: enable prefix KV cache flush for int4 variant to avoid stale quant params (temporary)
Maya: thanks all. please update thread with compare output and decision. :thumbsup:
